method: Untruncated scoped Git tree enumeration at pinned canonical main; parse literal CSQF2 JSON pin dictionary and D1B0 frozen dictionary plus direct source and consumer; read original schema-2 state by immutable blob; compare exact Git blob IDs at explicit archival mapping. No native preflight, checker, CI, proof, or fresh byte hashing.
scope: Selected two scientifically relevant historical workflows and 27 accepted anchors plus one blocked active contract. Counts are pin occurrences, not independent proof qualifications. No review of all archived workflow bodies.

roadmap.scope: File targets only; no fragment or external URL validation.

blockers: Archived workflow pin paths do not exist at old .github/workflows locations. Use exact archive mapping for historical donor pins; do not rewrite historical receipts or restore old executable definitions.
Old watchdog targets the frozen integration branch, not canonical main, and reads the old state as a live checkpoint.

Schema-2 checker requires LIVE CONSOLIDATION CHECKPOINT in BFSS_ACTIVE_ROADMAP.md and a live .github/workflows/bfss-roadmap-watch.yml; current roadmap intentionally lacks old live marker and workflow is archived.

HEAD^..HEAD guard was designed for single old active gate, not independent research programs or history-preserving merges. Do not relax it in place; retain historical contract and design a bounded current candidate contract.

decision: Keep all 864 workflows archived. No proof run, no restoration during freeze. New manual-dispatch-only workflow candidate must be scoped to one approved exact source/consumer gate and pinned archived donors, require main ref plus exact candidate SHA, read-only permissions, no automatic push/schedule triggers, cold toolchain and independent consumer, retain all first-causal evidence. Review before activation; prefer local Python and existing read-only RSKA tools.
